visual.problem: Top-left location tag («ԶԻԼ սառնարան, Երևանի կենդանաբանական այգի») uses very small, low-contrast text against the sky background, making it hard to read on mobile screens.
The closing quotation mark in «տարի» hangs awkwardly at the start of the caption line («տարի» պատմությունը լսում ենք), creating an awkward line break.
From 00:54 to 01:01, the visual drops to plain black background with text only, losing visual momentum compared to the earlier animations and historical footage.

hook.why: It taps into a ubiquitous cultural trope (grandma's indestructible Soviet fridge vs. modern appliances breaking in 5 years) and immediately poses an intriguing question.

pacing.problem: Stacking three rapid-fire examples in a row (old songs, 90-year-old smoker, university dropouts) after the Abraham Wald airplane story slows down the video's conclusion and pushes the runtime past 60 seconds.

clarity.summary_of_what_a_viewer_learns: The viewer learns about survivorship bias: why we mistakenly perceive older goods or successful college dropouts as standard when we only observe the ones that survived, ignoring the vast majority that failed or broke down.

top_3_fixes.1: Cut one of the secondary examples (e.g., the old music or smoking grandfather beat) to keep the total duration under 60 seconds and preserve high retention.

top_3_fixes.2: Add an engaging graphic or b-roll animation during the takeaway section (00:54-01:01) instead of plain text on a black background.

top_3_fixes.3: Increase the font size and add a semi-transparent dark backing behind the top-left contextual labels (00:00 and 00:07) for better legibility on mobile screens.
